_JsonConvention: All keys use PascalCase. Sections prefixed 'Config__'. Boolean flags use true/false. Paths use forward slashes.
_Purpose: Application defaults SSOT — every configurable feature reads its defaults from here. Keyboard/mouse controls live in Na__AppData__KeybindingsAndControls__.json.

Config__Canvas._description: SVG canvas rendering and display defaults — ValeSpec dark theme

Config__BoxSelect._description: Rubber-band selection overlay colours — Window (blue) vs Crossing (green)

Config__LassoSelect._description: Freehand lasso selection — same direction convention as box select

Config__Dimensions._description: Dimension tool styling and behaviour — annotation layer, not written to DXF

Config__UndoRedo._description: Undo/redo history depth and hot-cache persistence. MaxDepth is user-adjustable.

Config__DwgConversion._description: DWG → DXF conversion. Primary: ezdwg Python library (modern DWG only). Fallback: ODA File Converter — required for legacy DWG (e.g. R12/AC1009). Leave OdaConverter__ExePath as-is: version-numbered install folders under Program Files are auto-detected. Only set it manually for a non-standard install location.

Config__StandardsRegion._description: Standards-library exclusion on import. The studio CAD template fences its concept-design standards block with THREE nested rectangles, each offset ~100mm from the next, drawn in RGB 250,215,0. When that border is found, every entity inside it is skipped before parsing/explosion — it never reaches the canvas and never slows the load. No border found = nothing excluded. All distances are DRAWING UNITS (mm assumed).

Config__EntityPayload._description: Entity JSON payload size controls. A large drawing serialises to tens of MB of JSON that the server builds, HTTP ships, and the browser re-parses. Coordinates are rounded (3dp is sub-micron on a mm drawing; set -1 to disable), BYLAYER color/linetype are omitted since the Properties panel already defaults to BYLAYER when absent, and JSON responses are gzipped. Purely transport-level — nothing is lost from the working DXF.

Config__DxfExport._description: Export DXF behaviour. ExcludeStandardsRegion removes everything inside the standards marker border so the export matches the viewer (respects Config__StandardsRegion.Enabled). RebuildCleanDocument re-imports survivors into a fresh document so unused block definitions are left behind (measured 106 MB to 5.6 MB) - trade-offs: modelspace only, dimensions become non-associative, and entity types ezdxf cannot rebuild (REGION, MULTILEADER) are skipped and reported. Set false to export the full-fat document instead. SketchUpStrip__EntityTypes is the annotation/markup list the Export to SketchUp button removes - from modelspace AND from inside every surviving block definition.

Config__Upload._description: Upload/conversion progress overlay. Large DWGs run as a background job the browser polls for live progress. StatusPollInterval_ms controls how often the overlay refreshes the server-side stage/message.

Config__Connection._description: Local server reachability watchdog. The app polls Health__Endpoint on an interval; after Failure__ThresholdCount consecutive failures it declares the server disconnected and shows the offline banner. Network actions pre-flight against this state so a save can never fail silently.

Config__ProjectCache._description: Local filesystem paths for temporary and saved CAD files. Paths relative to the project root. WorkingBackups__* governs the snapshot folder used to make Shift+Delete (physical prune of the working DXF) undoable.

Config__ProjectSave._description: Versioned per-project save system. Each project gets its own subfolder containing versioned DXF + JSON metadata pairs.

Config__Hotkeys._description: DEPRECATED — controls moved to Na__AppData__KeybindingsAndControls__.json. Kept for backwards compatibility only.
